summary: 3D tea house time-management game on an Istanbul quay, built by Claude Sonnet 5.5 · İstanbul rıhtımında 3D çay ocağı zaman yönetimi oyunu, Claude Sonnet 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Four items on five stations: tea brews in the semaver, simit warms in the oven, coffee boils over if left, dirty glasses go to the sink
Seven 3-minute days with a coin target and 1-3 stars, new items and customer types each day, then an endless shift
A shop between days: second semaver, bigger tray (3 to 5 items), faster oven, extra tables, an apprentice, comfy stools
The ?auto bot plays with the same actions as a player and won 84 of 90 seeded games
60 fps on an Intel UHD GPU at 1280x720 on a busy day 6 with 31 draw calls; generated models with a procedural fallback

social.headline: Run a tiny Istanbul tea house: brew tea, warm simit, serve every table in time · Küçük bir çay ocağı işlet: çay demle, simit ısıt, her masaya yetiş
